player_facing_text: You are at Cinderwatch Gate District. Rain, choke traffic, a notice board, and gate watch pressure frame the missing patrol inquiry. Visible points of interest: Notice board. Known exits: Enter Cinderwatch, Follow the missing patrol rumor. The notice board lists taxes, curfew rules, and a warning about a missing patrol. A gate serjeant manages the crowd and keeps one eye on the roster board. A tavern runner trades hot stew and rumors near the rain barrel. Threadbare watchers and refugees cluster along the muddy gate line. Ash Compact census delays have tightened the eastern caravan choke point. rain spatters soot-dark stone; frayed banners hang above cinderwatch's eastern gate refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach; guards hold the choke while the crowd presses in Rain spatters soot-dark stone; frayed banners hang above Cinderwatch's eastern gate. A well-appointed townhouse overlooking the square flies noble colors, a quiet contrast to the mud and clamor. Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach; guards hold the choke while the crowd presses in. Nearby, a gate serjeant manages the crowd with a careful eye on the roster board. Threadbare watchers and ragged strangers cluster along the muddy gate line, wary and shifting beneath the cold drizzle. A tavern runner trades hot stew and whispered rumors near a rain barrel, drawing small crowds despite the chill. The notice board lists taxes, curfew rules, and a warning about a missing patrol. Ash Compact census delays have tightened the eastern caravan choke point, slowing traffic further and adding to the mounting tension at the gate.
